messages:
Jordan (Sales): heads-up — AcmeCorp SOW asks for a formal acceptance of a security exception: they require us to not use customer-managed keys (BYOK) for the first 12 months. They're pushing this in the SIG/CAIQ review. Can sec sign off on compensating controls?
Maria (SecEng): fyi, this is common in enterprise deals. main risk is key separation & export controls. what do they want exactly? link to question PDF?
Jordan (Sales): they marked control CC-3 'KMS BYOK' as not implemented. asking us to provide compensating controls and a risk acceptance letter. attaching: https://acmecorp.com/sig-response.pdf
Alex (Security Reviewer): quick take — acceptable only if we enforce strict tenant isolation + customer traffic ACLs + KMS with restricted admin roles. also need audit logging turned on and retention 1y.
Iris (Compliance): we can offer these as compensating controls but need legal + Aisha sign-off for formal risk acceptance. Also product must document the operational runbook for key compromise.
Maria (SecEng): proposed technical controls: 1) Dedicated VPC for customer in Redwood Private, 2) Per-tenant envelope keys managed by Redwood KMS (not customer BYOK) with HSM-backed root, 3) IAM policy restricting key admins to 3 people, 4) Real-time KMS access logs forwarded to customer SIEM and Redwood audit log retention = 365d.
Jordan (Sales): customer will accept those if we include SLA language and notify them within 24h of any key admin changes. They also want a monthly attestation.
Alex (Security Reviewer): include a compensating-control matrix in our response: map each missing SIG control to the technical + process control. also require quarterly internal review and notify sales if any deviation.
sec-bot: automated note: security-request-523 opened (link: https://redwood/sec-requests/523). assigned to Maria.
Maria (SecEng): opened ticket and draft of risk acceptance doc attached in ticket. I propose a 12-month timeboxed exception, with milestone at 6 months to revisit BYOK options (quantization/infra readiness).
Iris (Compliance): we need monitoring: enable file-level audit trails for any key rotation, and provide the customer with a read-only view into rotation logs via console. That covers transparency.
Aisha (VP Security): OK — I approve a conditional risk acceptance for 12 months provided these are met: dedicated VPC, HSM-backed KMS, 3-person admin max, 365d audit retention, realtime SIEM forwarding, monthly attestation to customer, contract clause with termination right if controls are violated. Maria, please finalize the risk acceptance letter and route to Legal for signature. Jordan, get customer's SLAs written into SOW.
Jordan (Sales): thanks! I'll update SOW and ask Acme for written confirmation on monthly attestation. ETA EOD Tuesday. :thumbsup:
Alex (Security Reviewer): I'll add the compensating-control mapping to the SIG response and attach Aisha's approval note.
Maria (SecEng): assigning action items in sec-ticket-523. I'll drop the draft here once ready.
Jordan (Sales): pinging Acme with proposed language now. will share their reply in this thread.
sec-bot: note: sec-ticket-523 status -> in-progress.
Maria (SecEng): draft is uploaded: https://redwood/sec-requests/523/draft-risk-acceptance.docx — pls review before I route to legal.
Iris (Compliance): will review by tomorrow.
Aisha (VP Security): leaving a formal signature once Legal signs off. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Sales): acme replied, they agreed to monthly attestation and the 12-month exception. sending the signed CAIQ response after SOW edits.
